# Ninja Adventure Asset Pack — vendored stand-in art (CC0)

Source: https://pixel-boy.itch.io/ninja-adventure-asset-pack (Pixel-boy & AAA), file
"Ninja Adventure - Asset Pack.zip" downloaded 2026-08-19. License: **CC0 1.0 Universal**
(`LICENSE.txt` verbatim from the pack; `README.md` is the authors' — "Attribution is not
required but appreciated", so we credit them in the game's credits anyway).

What is vendored: `Actor/` (characters, animals incl. dogs, monsters, bosses),
`Backgrounds/` (tilesets incl. `TilesetRelief` cliffs/plateaus, `TilesetNature`,
`TilesetWater`, `tileset_camp`, …), `FX/`, `Items/`, `Ui/`, `Palette.png`. Preview
images/GIFs stripped. **Not vendored:** `Audio/` (≈96 MB: 37 musics, 100+ SFX, jingles) —
fetch from the same zip when a sound round needs it; the pack's Godot 4 example project
(github.com/pixel-boy/NinjaAdventure) is a reference for how the authors slice their
sheets.

Role in Tarrock: **stand-in art so level and game design can be judged without the art
being the distraction** (director, 2026-08-19). Every asset from this pack is a
placeholder to be refined or replaced by Tarrock's own art (`godot/art/ART-REQUESTS.md`
is the replacement queue). Nothing here is canon art direction — the pack's bright
ninja/JRPG tone is deliberately not Tarrock's (`docs/design/art-audio.md`).

Grid: 16×16 tiles; characters 16×16 (4 directions); the game draws them at ×4.
